source.description: Posters where one shape leads and every other element has a stated place.

reasons.p_045: Five annotated phrases show which words placed which shape.
reasons.p_002: The same structure as the jazz poster, with the disc and the half circle swapped.
reasons.p_022: Coral on cream: the hierarchy holds even with a light background.
reasons.t_001: The same idea for products: the template reserves the headline area.
reasons.p_076: A travel poster that uses stripes in the sky as its hierarchy.
reasons.p_010: Headline bars above, product below: the simplest two-level layout.

source.body:
Each of these prompts says where its shapes go. That single habit keeps flat posters from turning into confetti.

## What do they have in common?

- One dominant shape, named first and given a position.
- Bars instead of lettering, so the layout survives without readable text.
- Four colours at most, plus the background.

target.title: 層次清晰的海報
target.description: 一個圖形主導、其餘元素都寫明位置的海報。

reasons.p_045: 五個標註短語展示了哪些詞決定了哪個圖形的位置。
reasons.p_002: 與爵士海報結構相同，只是圓盤和半圓互換了位置。
reasons.p_022: 奶油底配珊瑚色：淺色背景下層次依然成立。
reasons.t_001: 同樣的思路用於產品：範本預留了標題區域。
reasons.p_076: 用天空中的條紋建立層次的旅行海報。
reasons.p_010: 上方標題條、下方產品：最簡單的兩層佈局。

target.body:
這些提示詞都寫明了圖形的位置。正是這個習慣，讓扁平海報不會變成一堆碎紙屑。

## 它們有什麼共同點？

- 有一個主導圖形，最先出現並寫明位置。
- 用色條代替文字，即使沒有可讀的文字，版面依然成立。
- 除背景外最多四種顏色。

source.title: Quiet landscapes
source.description: Layered ridges, still water and plenty of empty sky, for backgrounds that stay out of the way.

reasons.p_042: Mist does the work that detail would otherwise do.
reasons.p_016: Five layers fading into fog: the most depth with the least drawing.
reasons.p_001: A warmer version with a low sun between the ridges.
reasons.t_002: Turn any of these into an ink painting with the scroll template.
reasons.p_088: At 3:1 the horizon alone is the subject.
reasons.p_098: Two annotated phrases show how the moon and the dark foreground were placed.

source.body:
Landscapes built from a few layered shapes. They work behind text because nothing in them asks for attention.

## How do I keep a landscape quiet?

- Order the layers from light to dark instead of adding detail.
- Name one light source and its position.
- Leave the sky empty; it is where the text goes.

target.title: 安靜的風景
target.description: 層疊的山脊、平靜的水面和大片留白的天空，適合不搶戲的背景。

reasons.p_042: 霧氣替代了細節的作用。
reasons.p_016: 五層山丘漸隱於霧中：用最少的筆墨得到最強的縱深。
reasons.p_001: 更暖的版本，低垂的太陽落在山脊之間。
reasons.t_002: 用水墨長卷範本，把任何一幅改成水墨畫。
reasons.p_088: 3:1 的比例下，海平線本身就是主體。
reasons.p_098: 兩個標註短語展示了月亮和深色前景是如何定位的。

target.body:
由少數幾層圖形構成的風景。放在文字後面也合適，因為畫面裡沒有任何東西爭奪注意力。

## 怎樣讓風景保持安靜？

- 用由淺到深的層次代替細節。
- 只寫一個光源及其位置。
- 讓天空保持空白，那裡是放文字的地方。

## Reaction stickers

Six nine-panel reaction sheets cover everyday replies, dog moods, office chats, social energy, encouragement and gaming. The portrait and dog sets need one reference photo each; the cat, raccoon, frog and ghost sets work from text alone. Each sheet is a single image to share. Exporting individual stickers is a separate workflow.

## Photo edits and shareable images

Make a two-person photo booth, a fictional pet newspaper, a two-panel meme, a weekend collage, a birthday card or a four-panel dog comic. The collage needs no reference photo; the other five need one or two as described in their input instructions. The three demonstration references are AI-generated. All image captions and generation prompts are in English, including on translated pages. Edit the nine captions in the six sticker templates or the name and age in the birthday template.

source.title: About Prompt Seen
source.description: What this library is, how prompts are tested, and what the sample entries are.
source.body:
Prompt Seen is a library of image prompts you can read, copy and adapt. Every entry shows the image it produced and marks which phrases in the prompt changed what.

## How are prompts tested?

Each prompt is run with a recorded model, date and parameters. The record is kept with the prompt as an example run, and the page shows when it was last tested. Entries with no recorded run are marked “Not verified”.

## What are the sample entries?

The 101 content images were generated with GPT Image using the prompts shown on their pages. Each has a recorded run and a visual review. The built-in tool does not expose the exact model snapshot or usage. Downloadable full-size images may use a lossless format conversion; display sizes are compressed separately. The earlier procedural sample runs are archived.

## How do I report a problem?

Open an issue in the project's repository for wrong information, broken pages or a licensing concern.

target.title: 關於 Prompt Seen
target.description: 這個資源庫是什麼、提示詞怎樣測試，以及樣例條目是什麼。
target.body:
Prompt Seen 是一個可以閱讀、複製和改寫的圖像提示詞資源庫。每個條目都展示它生成的圖像，並標出提示詞中哪些短語改變了什麼。

## 提示詞怎樣測試？

每條提示詞都會在記錄了模型、日期和參數的條件下運行。記錄作為生成示例與提示詞一起儲存，頁面顯示最後測試的日期。沒有運行記錄的條目標為「尚未驗證」。

## 樣例條目是什麼？

101 張內容圖片均由 GPT Image 根據頁面展示的提示詞生成，並保留運行記錄和視覺審核。內建工具未提供精確模型快照或用量。可下載的大圖可能經過無損格式轉換，展示尺寸另行壓縮。此前的程式繪圖樣例運行已歸檔。

## 怎樣報告問題？

## How are these landscapes built?

Almost every landscape here is a stack of shapes ordered from light to dark, with one light source. The prompts name the number of layers and the time of day rather than individual colours.

## Which one should I start with?

- For a wallpaper: [Morning mist over the hills](prompt:p_016), which leaves the sky empty.
- For a print: [Desert dunes in warm light](prompt:p_006).
- For an ink painting: the [ink scroll template](template:t_002).

target.title: 風景提示詞
target.description: 扁平向量與水墨風景：由幾層圖形構成的山脊、沙丘與海面。
target.body:
## 這些風景是怎樣構成的？

這裡幾乎每一幅風景都是由淺到深疊起來的幾層圖形，再加一個光源。提示詞寫的是層數和時刻，而不是逐個顏色。

## 從哪一個開始？

- 做桌布：[晨霧中的山丘](prompt:p_016)，天空留白。
- 做印刷品：[暖光下的沙丘](prompt:p_006)。
- 做水墨畫：[水墨長卷範本](template:t_002)。

source.title: Poster prompts
source.description: Geometric and retro posters that keep a clear hierarchy without readable text.
source.body:
## Why no lettering?

Image models still garble text. These prompts reserve bars for titles and dates, so the layout survives and the words can be set afterwards.

See the collection [Posters with a clear hierarchy](collection:c_001).

target.title: 海報提示詞
target.description: 不依賴可讀文字，仍能保持清楚層次的幾何與復古海報。
target.body:
## 為什麼不用文字？

圖像模型仍可能生成錯亂文字。這些提示詞為標題與日期預留色條，讓版面保持完整，之後再排上文字。

查看合集[層次清晰的海報](collection:c_001)。

source.title: 水墨风格提示词
source.description: 枝条、竹林与山峦的水墨提示词，重在笔触与留白。
source.body:
## 水墨提示词写什么？

写笔触而不是线条粗细：“枯笔”“湿笔晕染”比“粗线”“细线”更可靠。再写清印章的位置，否则它可能落在主体上。

可以从[水墨梅枝](prompt:p_012)开始，或者直接使用[水墨长卷模板](template:t_002)。

target.title: 水墨風格提示詞
target.description: 枝條、竹林與山巒的水墨提示詞，重在筆觸與留白。
target.body:
## 水墨提示詞寫什麼？

寫筆觸而不是線條粗細：“枯筆”“濕筆暈染”比“粗線”“細線”更可靠。再寫清印章的位置，否則它可能落在主體上。

可以從[水墨梅枝](prompt:p_012)開始，或者直接使用[水墨長卷範本](template:t_002)。
